issues: The program does not handle the case where the configuration file is empty.
The `validate_config` function does not check if the required fields are present in the configuration dictionary before trying to access them.
The `main` function does not provide any feedback when the configuration file is not a valid JSON document.
The program does not handle the case where the configuration file contains invalid or unsupported data types for the integer-range and boolean fields.
The `validate_config` function does not check if the values of the integer-range fields are within the specified range before trying to access them.
The program does not provide any feedback when the configuration is valid, it simply prints a success message and exits.
